Map code entry 4 (action 4): starts Base Cochise's self-destruct. Copies the elapsed count's low three bytes ($04, $05, $06) to countdown_start $F4FA-$F4FC, sets countdown_armed $F4F9 to 1 and the map header's byte +$2F to 0 (no random encounters), and shakes the screen twice: screen_shake through $044C at $4085, then explosion's JMP $044C ($4088), into which it runs. The game's countdown_check ($82B5, on every pass of the main loop) then waits for the count to be 240 or more past the start, 240 steps, battle rounds and V)iews that come back round to their first party on this map, each of which adds 1 (advance_clock $AF32; an hour of game time, four counts to a minute), and writes the map back and runs module 4, the destruction, wherever the party is. It returns with the carry that random_byte's last addition left ($24EC), so whether the game redraws the view ($8872) is left to chance. The record ($4005) then makes the square message square 3 ("SELF DESTRUCT IRREVERSIBLE! STATION NOW DETONATING! You hear several explosions in the background."), which becomes action square 7, the countdown clock. Action square 4 is the last step of the activation, made by remote change 3. First the four stations at the corners take their keys in turn, check squares 16-19 (Blackstar key at (1,1), Nova key at (30,1), Pulsar key at (30,30), Quasar key at (1,30); the next one is a force field, blocking square 1, until then). Then a key at any of them activates "safety procedure #1342-666" (question square 0; remote change 5 seals the panel behind each station, blocking square 0 at (2,3), (28,2), (3,29) and (29,28): "...the panel behind you has been sealed shut."), and the stations must be pressed Red at (1,1), Yellow at (30,30), Green at (1,30) and Blue at (30,1) (question squares 2-5; a wrong one of the keys R, Y, G and B, or one pressed at a station out of turn: "Incorrect activation sequence. Procedure aborted." and the procedure starts again; any other key changes nothing). The fourth, message square 29 ("Phase 4 activated. ALERT! Self destruction sequence activated. ..."), becomes remote change 3, which also makes eight squares action squares 5 and 6 (explosions), the four stations action square 7 (the clock) and (16,9) exit 16, an escape pod to map 17 ("ESCAPE POD ACTIVATED. NEXT POD BEING PREPARED.").

records.c: Map code entry 6 (action 6): shows the self-destruct countdown, "The screen shows a clock counting down. It shows h:mm.ss." (messages 17 and 18; 18 ends with the RETURN prompt, code {06}). The time left is 240 less the elapsed count's progress since countdown_start, low two bytes only ($408B-$40AA), in counts, four to a game minute on this map (header +$34/+$36: a quarter-minute and one count a step), so the clock starts at 1:00. The seconds are 0, 15, 30 or 45 by the count left AND 3 (quarter_seconds, $40AD-$40B5); two right shifts make minutes ($40B8-$40C1); minutes_to_hours divides them by 60 for the hours ($40C9) and again for the minutes, its remainder in $D3 ($40D8). print_byte prints the hours and the seconds without leading zeros, so a whole minute ends in ".0"; the minutes take two digits padded with '0' ($40D4-$40E4). Returns carry set, so the game redraws the view after the prompt ($8872). Action square 7 runs it (record $400E, whose change $FF writes nothing, so the square stays and shows the clock every time): the square where arm_self_destruct ran, after message square 3, and the four stations (1,1), (30,1), (30,30) and (1,30), made by remote change 3.

Operand of the LDA # at $40AD, written at run time: the low byte of the count's progress since the start ($4091), then of the time left, 240 less it ($40A2), then of the minutes left (ROR at $40BB and $40C1). Read by the SBC at $409F, as the immediate at $40AD for the seconds and by minutes_to_hours at $40F8.

records.c: Divides the minutes left by 60: A = the low byte (the operand at $40AE), X = the high byte (the operand at $40FC), Y = 60, then divide_16_by_8 ($0410): the hours in A (and X), the minutes left over in $D3. Called by show_countdown at $40C9, for the hours it prints, and at $40D8, for the remainder it prints as the minutes.

Operand of the LDX # at $40FB in minutes_to_hours, written at run time: the high byte of the progress ($4099), of the time left ($40AA) and of the minutes left (LSR at $40B8 and $40BE), the dividend's high byte.
